```{r Load Packages and Data Sets}
library(tidyverse)
library(stargazer)
library(pscl)

setwd("~/Projects/Master-Thesis-Spatial-Proximity-Venture-Capital")
data <- read_csv("data/sets-for-r/data_germany.csv")
```



```{r}
ivs <- c(
  "seed_investor_same_city", "follow_on_after_3_year", "number_of_founders", "age", "founded_year", "hub_binary", "b2b_binary", "number_seed_rounds", "number_seed_investors",
  "accelerator_funding_binary", "angel_group_funding_binary", "micro_vc_funding_binary", "corporate_vc_funding_binary", "energy", "materials", "industrials", "consumer_discretionary",
  "consumer_staples", "health_care", "financials",
  "information_technology", "communication_services",
  "utilities", "real_estate", "other"
)

dv <- "success"

logit_formula <- reformulate(ivs, dv)

model_logit <- glm(logit_formula,
                   data   = data,
                   family = binomial(link = "logit"))

pr2 <- pR2(model_logit)["McFadden"]

stargazer(
  model_logit,
  type                   = "text",
  title                  = "Einfache logistische Regression",
  dep.var.labels.include = FALSE,
  star.cutoffs           = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
  signif.stars           = TRUE,
  report                 = "vc*p",   # Koeff., SE und p-Werte
  digits                 = 3,
  omit.stat              = c("aic", "ll"),
  add.lines              = list(
    c("McFadden’s Pseudo-R²", formatC(pr2, digits = 3))
  )
)
```


```{r}
ivs <- c(
  "homecountry_investor_in_seed_binary", "number_of_founders", "age", "hub_binary", "b2b_binary",
  "energy", "materials", "industrials", "consumer_discretionary",
  "consumer_staples", "health_care", "financials",
  "information_technology", "communication_services",
  "utilities", "real_estate", "other"
)

dv <- "years_to_exit" 

lm_formula <- reformulate(ivs, dv)

model_lm <- lm(lm_formula, data = data)

model_sum <- summary(model_lm)
r2      <- model_sum$r.squared
adj_r2  <- model_sum$adj.r.squared

stargazer(
  model_lm,
  type                   = "text",
  title                  = "Lineare Regression",
  dep.var.labels.include = FALSE,
  star.cutoffs           = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
  signif.stars           = TRUE,
  report                 = "vc*p", 
  digits                 = 3,
  omit.stat              = c("f", "ser"),  
  add.lines = list(
    c("R-squared",        formatC(r2,     digits = 3)),
    c("Adj. R-squared",   formatC(adj_r2, digits = 3))
  )
)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stargazer)
library(pscl)

fit_models <- function(dat, center = FALSE) {
  df <- dat
  
  # 1) Optional Moderator zentrieren
  if (center) {
    mu <- mean(df$degree_homecountry, na.rm = TRUE)
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        mod_c    = degree_homecountry - mu,
        home_int = seed_investor_same_city * mod_c
      )
    mod_name   <- "mod_c"
    int_name   <- "home_int"
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        mod_c    = target_vc_in_seed_binary,
        home_int = seed_investor_same_city * target_vc_in_seed_binary
      )
    mod_name   <- "target_vc_in_seed_binary"
    int_name   <- "home_int"
  }
  
  # 2) Prädiktorenlisten bauen
  ivs <- c(
    "seed_investor_same_city", "number_of_founders", "age", "founded_year",
    "hub_binary", "b2b_binary", "number_seed_rounds", "number_seed_investors",
    "accelerator_funding_binary", "angel_group_funding_binary",
    "micro_vc_funding_binary", "corporate_vc_funding_binary",
    "energy", "materials", "industrials", "consumer_discretionary",
    "consumer_staples", "health_care", "financials",
    "information_technology", "communication_services",
    "utilities", "real_estate", "other"
  )
  
  # Basismodell
  f1 <- reformulate(ivs, "success")
  # mit Moderator
  f2 <- reformulate(c(ivs, mod_name), "success")
  # mit Interaction
  f3 <- reformulate(c(ivs, mod_name, int_name), "success")
  
  # 3) Fitten
  m1 <- glm(f1, data = df, family = binomial)
  m2 <- glm(f2, data = df, family = binomial)
  m3 <- glm(f3, data = df, family = binomial)
  
  # 4) Pseudo-R²
  pr2 <- sapply(list(m1, m2, m3), function(m) pR2(m)["McFadden"])
  
  # 5) Ausgabe
  stargazer(
    m1, m2, m3,
    type            = "text",
    title           = paste0(
      "Moderationsanalyse (Logit) — ",
      if (center) "Moderator zentriert" else "Original-Moderator"
    ),
    dep.var.labels.include = FALSE,
    column.labels   = c("Baseline", "Mit Moderator", "Mit Interaktion"),
    omit.stat       = c("aic", "ll"),
    star.cutoffs    = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
    signif.stars    = TRUE,
    report          = "vc*p",
    digits          = 3,
    add.lines       = list(
      c("McFadden’s Pseudo-R² (Mod1)", formatC(pr2[1], digits = 3)),
      c("McFadden’s Pseudo-R² (Mod2)", formatC(pr2[2], digits = 3)),
      c("McFadden’s Pseudo-R² (Mod3)", formatC(pr2[3], digits = 3))
    )
  )
}

# Anwendung:
# Ohne Zentrierung
fit_models(data, center = FALSE)

# Mit Mittelwert-Zentrierung
fit_models(data, center = TRUE)
```
